current_findings_summary.P04_classification_basis: Major: the false Cox-group product is an essential local-descent bridge in the original proof of Lemma 3.20 and hence the main equivariant characteristic-class formula of Theorem 3.21 (p.43). The alternative localization derivation repeats the same invalid splitting on p.61, so it does not independently remove this core proof gap. The verified invariant-monomial replacement restores the result without splitting the finite-kernel sequence. No counterexample to the characteristic-class identity is inferred; the severity concerns the original invalid core derivation.

non_counted_editorial_clarifications.exclusion_reason: Excluded from substantive findings: the wrong divisor-translation sign occurs only in the transitional equivariant-sheaf sentence on p.40. Equation (2.16) on p.20 and the actual character calculation on p.41 already use the correct direction and exponential factor. The interval example refutes the isolated sentence, but no essential calculation or conclusion is shown to propagate that sign. Under the operative rule excluding typographical errors alone, retain this as an uncounted editorial clarification, not a Minor finding.
